prose.subject: Friendly Reminder: Invoice INV-62579
prose.body:
Hi Corvane Labs team,

Hope you're having a great week! Just a quick, friendly nudge regarding invoice INV-62579 for the amount of 6110.38 USDC. We wanted to ensure it hasn't slipped through the cracks on your end.

To settle this, please transfer the funds to our standard receiving wallet: 0xc2f9f1f42a33aae78fd6f432fa6039ffc6e74c30. This is the same address we've used for previous settlements, so no changes to your records are needed.

If you've already sent this over, please consider this a confirmation from our side. If you have any questions about the invoice details or need a copy sent again, just hit reply and we'll sort it out right away.

Thanks so much for your prompt attention to this! We look forward to continuing our smooth collaboration.

Best regards,

Alex Thorne
Accounts Receivable
Rowan Legal
